RW-04 route family implemented at commit 9fb6122. All 4 routes live: POST /api/v1/experiments/launch, GET /api/v1/experiments, GET /api/v1/experiments/{experiment_id}, POST /api/v1/experiments/{experiment_id}/cancel. 19 contract tests pass including canCancel invariants and queued->canceled direct path. State machine aligned to published contract. No regressions in RW-01/02/03.

Review found a production-path bug: RW-04 experiments currently read/write via local fallback only. With allow_local_snapshot_fallback=false, a launched experiment cannot be listed, fetched, or canceled. Rework RW-04 to use the service-backed research_experiments dataset and add a non-fallback regression test before re-review.

Production-path bug fixed at commit 9789f8b. Root cause: list/get/cancel_research_experiment used _local_fallback() which returns None with allow_local_snapshot_fallback=False. Fix: added _research_experiments_store() routing reads through ServiceBackedReadAdapter (same snapshot file create writes to), cancel uses self._data directly, create uses self._data for ID generation. Added 2 non-fallback regression tests (test_rw04_no_fallback_launch_list_detail_cancel_round_trip, test_rw04_no_fallback_missing_experiment_returns_404). All 21 RW-04 contract tests pass.

RW-04 production-path fix verified at 9789f8b. Non-fallback launch/list/detail/cancel now works through the service-backed research_experiments store; RW-04 and adjacent RW-01/02/03 contract tests pass. Owner should finalize to done.
